task.target_environment: dev integration (shared long-lived pantheon compose project)
task.title: Fix L12 research-loops harness truncating large readback responses

root_cause.summary: The deployed research-loops E2E harness's DeployedResearchHarness._http_json() read a successful HTTP response with response.read(32_768) before decoding and json.loads()-ing it. source.authority_actual_state calls GET /api/source-ingest/controller/readback, whose payload (full connector registry, schedule, and DLQ/record counts) grows with the shared default 'pantheon' compose environment's accumulated history. On the live environment this task ran against, that payload had grown to ~1.24 MB, well past the 32 KiB cap, so the read silently truncated mid-string and json.loads() reported the truncated body as 'returned non-JSON content'. This reads as an API defect in source-ingestion; the actual cause is the test harness under-reading its own successful response before parsing it.
candidates_ruled_out: source-ingestion controller/readback endpoint correctness: the endpoint returns a complete, valid JSON body; parsing only failed on the truncated prefix the harness itself produced by capping the read.
root_cause.confirmed_cause: DeployedResearchHarness._http_json() capped a successful response read at 32,768 bytes before decoding and parsing, independent of the actual response size; GET /api/source-ingest/controller/readback on the live default pantheon compose now returns ~1.24 MB.
reproduction: Live deployed pantheon compose stack, before fix: reading the first 32,768 bytes of the live controller/readback response and parsing with json.loads() raises 'Unterminated string starting at: line 1 column 32767'.
Live deployed pantheon compose stack, after fix: reading up to 16,777,216 bytes of the same live response reads the full 1,249,201-byte body and json.loads() parses it cleanly.

changes: Raised DeployedResearchHarness._http_json()'s successful-response read cap from response.read(32_768) to response.read(16_777_216) (16 MiB), with a comment explaining why the controller/readback payload can grow past the old cap and why a too-small cap fails silently as a 'non-JSON content' parse error instead of loudly.
fix.not_changing: services/source_ingestion/main.py and every other product read path are unmodified; the HTTPError branch's error-body read (exc.read(4_096)) is unmodified; no other loop harness's _http_json usage or read cap is touched.
fix.owned_layer: Deployed E2E harness's HTTP successful-response read cap for the controller/readback boundary only.

commands.command: Direct before/after reproduction against the live default-compose controller/readback endpoint (see root_cause.reproduction above)
commands.conclusion: 32,768-byte read truncates and fails json.loads() with 'Unterminated string starting at: line 1 column 32767'; 16,777,216-byte read captures the full 1,249,201-byte body and parses cleanly.
